hints.title: Review DNS roles
hints.detail: Confirm whether the detected DNS-capable hosts are expected to serve DNS, and inspect their forwarding or recursion configuration if they appear unusual.

hints.title: Enable mandatory SMB signing
hints.detail: On Windows Server: enable 'Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (always)' via Group Policy (Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Local Policies > Security Options). On Linux/Samba: set 'server signing = mandatory' in smb.conf and restart the service. Mandatory SMB signing prevents relay attacks where an attacker intercepts and forwards authentication exchanges.
